headline: Apple Briefly Surpasses Nvidia as World's Most Valuable Company
summary: Apple's market capitalization briefly surpassed Nvidia following strong demand for its new foldable iPhone Duo, reaching record valuations.
why: Apple and Nvidia are anchor stocks in global equity benchmarks, and fluctuations in their relative market capitalization drive broader tech sector sentiment.

impacts.name: Apple
impacts.why: Rapid sellouts of new hardware cycles reinforce strong consumer demand and drive near-term revenue growth expectations.

why_moved: Strong consumer adoption of the new foldable iPhone Duo drove up Apple shares, briefly vaulting it past Nvidia in total market valuation.
